verdict.rationale: Glama's MCP Inspector lets users test any MCP server from the browser (including local servers via tunnel) without deploying to production, and hosting is 'private by default' with per-tool access control — functionally supporting isolated testing before going live. However, there is no explicit sandbox/staging environment concept, no mention of test vs production data separation, and no independent confirmation of this workflow. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment terminology, guarantees about production data isolation, and third-party validation of safe pre-production testing.
